card.name: The word to after continue
card.fires_on: The word "to" right after a form of "continue" (continue, continues, continued) where an ongoing action follows. It appears in general prose, news and label text alike.

modes.label: continue to + verb
modes.description: "to" directly after "continue" introduces the ongoing action, such as remain, grow or search.
modes.example: Scientists continue<< to>> search for the answer.

card.writes: The promoted and suppressed tokens are mixed and give no clear output effect.
card.plain: It fires on the word "to" in "continue to", just before the verb that says what keeps happening.
